# Tunnel Whitespace

> Tunnel Whitespace is a free screening map of tunnel car wash supply against population for every census tract in the United States. It compares the people living within about a 10-minute drive of each tract with the 11,854 operating tunnel car washes (express, full-serve and flex) and 347 reported in development, and shows where population could support more tunnels.

Built by Anthony Warren (First Vice President, Car Washes, Southeast, Matthews Real Estate Investment Services). Population: Esri 2024 estimates. Tunnel car wash locations verified October 2026. Updated October 29, 2026. Screening estimates for research, not investment advice. Cite as: Tunnel Whitespace, tunnelwhitespace.com.

## Pages

- [U.S. map](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/): interactive map (requires JavaScript)
- [Southeast map](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/southeast/): NC, SC, GA, VA, TN, FL and AL
- [Top 100 U.S. metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/): ranking table at one tunnel per 20,000 people
- [Southeast metros](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/markets/southeast/): all 182 Southeast metro and micro areas ranked
- [Method, sources and FAQ](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/about/): how the gap is calculated and what the map does not show

## Optional

- [Full text for language models](https://tunnelwhitespace.com/llms-full.txt): method, FAQ and both ranking tables in one Markdown file
- [Interactive map (ArcGIS)](https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/6101a0eeeaf14029bf49495ef8baab85/): requires JavaScript
